blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omnimodal evaluation should go beyond independent text, image, and speech production: individually plausible outputs may not express a coherent shared event. We introduce Omni-StoryBench , a story-grounded omnimodal benchmark evaluating whether models can coherently continue stories across image, narration, and speech. Each instance provides a current storybook page and structured next-page conditions, requiring models to generate the next illustration, narration, and spoken character utterance. Omni-StoryBench contains 900 rigorously validated story transitions from openly licensed children’s books, with ground-truth next-page references and speech metadata. We evaluate systems with modality-specific metrics and consistency-centered LLM-as-a-judge rubrics for context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Across 32 baseline configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any paradigms, we find orchestration with strong VLM planning most reliable, while current native omnimodal models often struggle with output completeness and controllability. Our analysis shows text-side performance is associated with image and speech quality, but image generation and visual continuity form the clearest observed bottleneck among the evaluated configurations. These results position Omni-StoryBench as a system-level benchmark measuring coherent omnimodal generation beyond isolated modality quality.
blocks.zh: 模式评价应超越独立的文本、图像和语音制作:个别可信的产出可能无法表达一致的共享活动。 我们介绍Omni-Story Bench, 一个基于故事的全方位基准, 每个实例都提供当前的故事书页面和结构化的下页条件,需要模型生成下一个插图,叙事和口语字符的表达. Omni-Story Bench 载有900篇经过严格验证的故事, 我们用特定模式的衡量尺度和以一致性为中心的LLM-as-a-judge为主的术语来评价各种系统,以维护环境、遵循条件、参考一致性和跨模式一致性。 在32个包括管弦乐、半管弦乐和本土任意模式的基线配置中,我们发现管弦乐与强力的VLM规划最为可靠,而目前的本土全方位模型往往与输出完整性和可控性相冲突。 我们的分析显示文本侧面的性能与图像和语音质量相关,但图像生成和视觉连续性在被评价的配置中构成了最明显的观察到的瓶颈. 这些结果将Omni-Story Bench定位为衡量超过孤立模式质量的连贯的全模式生成的系统级基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent foundation models are rapidly evolving from text-centric systems ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Chowdhery et al., 2023 ) into multimodal generators producing outputs including text, images, and speech ( Sun et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Chameleon Team, 2024 ) , and ultimately toward omnimodal systems supporting any-to-any generation ( Kim et al., 2026a ; OpenAI et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Luo et al., 2025 ) .
As AI systems move toward more natural interaction, generation must extend beyond isolated text responses to coordinated multimodal outputs ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ) .
Such capability is central to emerging applications including interactive education and accessibility ( Hyeon et al., 2025b ; Aslan et al., 2024 ; Hyeon et al., 2025a ; Jung et al., 2024 ) , digital storytelling ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Kyaw and Sivalingam, 2025 ) , virtual assistants ( Todericiu, 2025 ) , embodied agents ( Suglia et al., 2022 ) , and creative content production ( Polyak et al., 2025 ; Hyeon et al., 2024 ) , where users increasingly expect accurate, visually grounded, temporally coherent, and socially expressive responses.
Here, language can describe events and reasoning, images can ground them visually, and speech can convey character intent, emotion, and social nuance.
blocks.zh:
最近的基础模型正在从以文本为中心的系统迅速演变 (Brown等人,2020年;Chowdhery等人,2023年)变成多式联运发电机,产生包括文本、图像和语音在内的产出(Sun等人,2024年a; 徐等人,2025年a; Yang等人,2025c;Xie等人,2025年;Chameleon Team,2024年),并最终走向支持任何一代人的所有模式系统(Kim等人,2026a;OpenAI等人,2024年;Li等人,2026a;Zhan等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024a;Luo等人,2025年)。
随着人工智能系统走向更自然的互动,生成必须超越对协调的多式联运产出的孤立文本反应(Li等人,2026b;Zhan等人,2024;Wu等人,2024a).
这种能力对新兴应用至关重要,包括互动教育和无障碍(Hyeon等人,2025年b;Aslan等人,2024年;Hyeon等人,2025年a;Jung等人,2024年),数字故事讲解(Yang等人,2024年;Kyaw和Sivalingam,2025年),虚拟助手(Todericiu,2025年),代表物(Suglia等人,2022年),以及创造性内容制作(Polyak等人,2025年;Hyeon等人,2024年),其中用户越来越期望得到准确、基于视觉、时间一致和社会表达的反应。
在这里,语言可以描述事件和推理,图像可以俯视它们,而语音可以传达人物意图,情感,以及社会细微.

blocks.en:
However, omnimodal generation is not simply about enabling a model or pipeline to generate text, images, and speech.
It must satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously. Each modality must preserve generation quality, such as producing visually plausible images, fluent, accurate descriptions, and natural-sounding speech. The outputs must also remain aligned in entities, events, actions, emotions, and context. Beyond modality-specific quality, holistic omnimodal evaluation must therefore assess outputs’ mutual consistency and coherence as a joint response ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . This requirement applies across architectural paradigms, from orchestration-based pipelines connecting external modality-specific generators to native any-to-any models attempting multimodal generation within a unified framework. A system may produce individually plausible outputs yet fail to express the same narrative state across them.
blocks.zh:
然而,全模式生成并不仅仅是要让一个模型或管道生成文本、图像和语音。
它必须同时满足多重目标。 每种方式必须保持生成质量,例如制作视觉上可信的图像、流利、准确的描述和自然声音。 产出还必须在实体、活动、行动、情绪和背景方面保持协调一致。 因此,除了特定模式的质量外,整体的全方位评价必须评估产出的相互一致性和连贯性,作为联合对策(Zhang等人,2024b;Liu等人,2024a)。 这一要求适用于建筑范式,从将外部模式特定发电机连接起来的以管线为基础的管道,到试图在一个统一框架内生产多式联运的本地任何到任何模式。 一个系统可能单独产生可信的产出,但未能在其中表达同样的叙述状态。

Given the current scene image, narration text, and structured generation conditions, models generate the next scene’s image, narration, and spoken character utterance. The generated triplet is evaluated against the structured conditions and ground-truth references for modality-specific quality and cross-modal consistency. blocks.zh: 图1:Omni-Story Bench概览. 鉴于目前的场景图像、叙事文本和结构化的生成条件,模型生成下一场景的图像、叙事和口语字符的表达。 所生成的三胞胎是根据结构化条件和关于模式特定质量和跨模式一致性的地面实况参考资料加以评价的。 顶端输出显示任何一代人之间,而底端输出则显示一种管弦法。

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks address complementary aspects of this problem. MME-Unify ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , MMMG ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , and MMCBench ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) evaluate unified understanding-generation, multitask multimodal generation, and cross-modal robustness, respectively. UniM ( Li et al., 2026b ) further evaluates broad any-to-any interleaved generation, explicitly including interleaved coherence. Building on these advances, we focus on a specific evaluation question: can a system preserve a given story context while realizing a specified next narrative state consistently across image, narration, and speech? Answering this question requires assessing both the transition from the current context to the intended next state and the agreement among all three generated outputs. A coherent triplet can still violate the intended transition, while individually plausible outputs can contradict one another. A dedicated benchmark should therefore evaluate narrative grounding and cross-modal consistency together for each transition.
blocks.zh: 现有基准涉及这一问题的互补方面。 MME-统一(谢等人,2026年),MMMG(姚等人,2025年),MMC Bench(张等人,2024年a)分别评价统一理解生成,多任务多式联运生成,跨模式稳健性. Unim(Li等人,2026年b)进一步评价了任意对任意互叶的生成,明确包括互叶的一致性。 在这些进展的基础上,我们侧重于一个具体的评价问题:一个系统能否保留一个特定的故事背景,同时在图像、叙述和发言之间一致地实现一个具体的下一个叙述状态? 要回答这个问题,就需要评估从当前环境向预期下一个状态的过渡,以及所有三个产出之间的协议。 协调一致的三重奏仍然可能违反预期的过渡,而个别可行的产出则可能相互矛盾。 因此,每个过渡都应有一个专门的基准,共同评价叙述基础和交叉模式的一致性。

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we introduce Omni-StoryBench, a storybook-grounded benchmark testing coherent omnimodal continuation across vision, language, and speech.
Fairy-tale storybooks offer a controlled yet semantically rich testbed, containing recurring characters, evolving events, visually grounded scenes, and character dialogues. Their paired illustrations and narration provide concrete references for evaluating page-to-page changes in characters, actions, and scene semantics.
Each instance (Figure 1 ) provides a current page image, corresponding narration, and structured generation conditions, including book-level metadata, character information, and the next-page description. Given this context, a model must generate the next-page image, corresponding narration, and a spoken character utterance with appropriate delivery. The conditions specify the intended next narrative state, and the system must realize that state consistently across all three modalities while preserving continuity with the current page. Omni-StoryBench thus targets story-grounded, condition-controlled page continuation; its intentionally constrained scope enables focused evaluation of these aspects.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Omni-Story Bench, 一种基于故事本的基准测试 一致的全方位模式 跨越视觉、语言和语言。
Fairy-tale故事书提供了一个可控但内容丰富的试验床,包括反复出现的人物、不断演变的事件、视网膜场景和人物对话。 他们的配对插图和叙述为评价人物,动作和场景语义的逐页变化提供了具体的参考.
每个实例(图1)提供当前页面图像,相应的描述,以及结构化生成条件,包括书级元数据,字符信息,以及下一页描述. 在这种情况下,模型必须生成下一页的图像、相应的叙述以及用适当方式表达的口语特征。 有关条件具体规定了预期的下一个叙述状态,系统必须在保持与当前页面的连续性的同时,在所有三种模式中一致地认识到这一状态。 因此,Omni-Story Bench针对的是基于故事的、条件控制的网页延续;其有意限制的范围使得能够对这些方面进行重点评价。

blocks.en: Omni-StoryBench contains 900 story transitions from openly licensed children’s books, with model-assisted annotations reviewed and revised by human annotators. Our evaluation combines modality-specific metrics with three-judge ensembles for text, image, speech, and integrated assessment, covering context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. We report output completeness separately from quality conditional on output and valid-score availability, and provide complementary zero-filled results. Experiments with 32 system configurations show that strong VLM-based orchestration achieves the highest overall scores and reliable completion, while native any-to-any systems exhibit substantial variation in quality and completeness. Across the evaluated configurations, text-side performance is strongly associated with image and speech quality, and preserving visual continuity emerges as a central challenge. Independent human evaluation and sensitivity analyses support broad system comparisons while identifying limitations in speech evaluation and fine-grained rankings.
blocks.zh: Omni-Story Bench载有900本公开发行的儿童书籍的故事过渡,其中模型辅助说明由人类注释员审查和修订. 我们的评价将特定模式的衡量标准与文本、图像、言论和综合评估的三位法官合在一起,涵盖上下文保护、遵循条件、参考一致性和跨模式一致性。 我们以产出和有效分数可用性为条件,报告产出完整性与质量分开,并提供补充性的零填充结果。 具有32个系统配置的实验表明,强大的基于VLM的管弦乐能实现最高的整体分数和可靠的完成,而原生的任意到任何系统在质量和完整性上都表现出巨大的差异. 在整个评价的配置中,文本侧性能与图像和语音质量密切相关,维护视觉连续性成为一项核心挑战。 独立的人类评价和敏感性分析支持广泛的系统比较,同时确定语音评价和精细排名的局限性。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: - A benchmark for story-grounded omnimodal generation: We introduce 900 human-validated story transitions with structured next-page conditions and reference annotations to evaluate coordinated image, narration, and speech generation.
blocks.zh: - 以故事为基础的全方位模式生成基准: 我们引入了900个经过人验证的故事过渡,并附有结构化的下页条件和参考说明,以评估协调的图像、叙述和语音生成。

blocks.en: - A consistency-centered evaluation framework: We combine modality-specific metrics with multimodal judge rubrics to assess contextual grounding, narrative continuity, condition compliance, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence, alongside separate output completeness reporting.
blocks.zh: - 以一致性为中心的评价框架: 我们把针对具体模式的衡量标准与多式联运法官的衡量标准结合起来,以评估背景基础、叙述连续性、遵守条件、参考一致性和跨模式一致性,同时进行单独的产出完整性报告。

blocks.en: - An empirical study of current omnimodal systems: We benchmark 32 configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any generation, identifying gaps in output completeness, controllability, and visual continuity, with human evaluation and robustness analyses supporting interpretation of the results.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 对目前所有制的经验研究: 我们以32个配置为基准,包括管弦乐、半管弦乐和任何一代人,找出产出完整性、可控性和视觉连续性方面的差距,并用人的评价和强健性分析来支持对结果的解释。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Omnimodal Generation Systems. Recent multimodal generation systems have expanded from text-image generation toward omnimodal interaction.
Models including Emu ( Sun et al., 2024b ) , Emu2 ( Sun et al., 2024a ) , Chameleon ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ) , Show-o ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , Janus-Pro ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , and VILA-U ( Wu et al., 2024b ) unify language and vision for interleaved image-text generation, visual understanding, and text-to-image generation; Emu and Emu2 also support image editing, and VILA-U covers video.
Others add speech and audio generation: Qwen2.5-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025a ) perceives text, images, audio, and video, generating text and speech in a streaming manner, while HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni ( NAVER Cloud HyperCLOVA X Team, 2026 ) supports text, audio, and vision inputs and outputs in an any-to-any omnimodal framework.
More general systems including NExT-GPT ( Wu et al., 2024a ) , AnyGPT ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , NExT-OMNI ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , and Dynin-Omni ( Kim et al., 2026a ) explore arbitrary multimodal input-output combinations through diffusion-based decoders or unified discrete sequence modeling or discrete flow matching.
blocks.zh:
Omnimodule生成系统. 近期的多式联运生成系统已经从文本图像生成扩展到了全模式互动。
模式包括: 埃穆(Sun等人,2024年b),埃穆(Sun等人,2024年a),变色龙. (变色龙队,2024年), Show-o (Xie等人,2025年),Janus-Pro(Chen等人,2025年b),以及VILA-U(Wu等人,2024年b)统一语言和愿景,实现互页图像文本生成,视觉理解,以及文本到图像生成;Emu和Emu2也支持图像编辑,VILA-U覆盖视频.
其他人加入语音和音频生成: Quen2.5-Omni(徐等人,2025年a)感知文本、图像、音频和视频,以流畅的方式生成文本和言论,而HyperClOVA X 8B Omni(NAVER) 云层超CLOVA X Team, 2026)支持任何到任何全模式框架中的文本,音频和视觉投入和产出.
更一般的系统包括NExT-GPT(Wu等人,2024a),AnyGPT(Zhan等人,2024),NExT-OMNI(Luo等人,2025),以及Dynin-Omni(Kim等人,2026a)通过扩散基解码器或统一的离散序列模型或离散流量匹配,探索任意的多式联运输入输出组合.

blocks.en:
Multimodal Benchmarks. Existing multimodal benchmarks evaluate capabilities including perception, vision-language reasoning, expert-domain reasoning, and video understanding.
Examples include MME ( Fu et al., 2023a ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , MM-Vet ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , SEED-Bench ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) .
However, these benchmarks primarily target QA-style understanding rather than multimodal generation.
Recent efforts such as MME-Unify ( Xie et al., 2026 ) and Uni-MMMU ( Zou et al., 2025 ) extend evaluation toward unified understanding-generation or mixed-modality tasks, while MMMG ( Yao et al., 2025 ) and MMCBench ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) consider generation-oriented and cross-modal settings.
Nevertheless, they remain largely modality-specific, pairwise, or limited to two-modality combinations.
Interleaved generation benchmarks, including InterleavedBench ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , MMIE ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , ISG-Bench ( Chen and others, 2025 ) , and OpenING ( Zhou and others, 2024 ) , evaluate coherence across generated image-text sequences.
UniM ( Li et al., 2026b ) broadens any-to-any interleaved evaluation across multiple modalities.
Yet these tasks are generally framed as instruction-following or open-domain interleaved generation, rather than sequential story-grounded continuation.
blocks.zh:
多式联运基准。 现有的多式联运基准评估能力,包括感知、视觉语言推理、专家领域推理和视频理解。
例如MME(Fu等人,2023年a),MMBench(Liu等人,2024年b),MM-Vet(Yu等人,2024年),MMMU(Yue等人,2024年),SEED-Bench(Li等人,2023年)和Video-MME(Fu等人,2025年).
然而,这些基准主要针对质量保证式的理解,而不是多式联运。
最近的努力,如MME-Unify(Xie等人,2026年)和Uni-MMMU(Zou等人,2025年),将评价扩大到统一的理解生成或混合模式任务,而MMMG(姚等人,2025年)和MMC Bench(张等人,2024年a年)则考虑了面向生成和交叉模式的设置。
然而,它们在很大程度上仍然是模式特有的、对偶的或仅限于两种模式的组合。
Interleaved生成基准,包括Interleaved Bench(刘等,2024a),MMIE(霞等,2025),ISG-Bench(陈等,2025),OpenING(周等,2024),评价生成的图像文本序列的一致性.
UniM(Li等人,2026年b)将任何互换评价扩展到多种模式。
然而,这些任务一般被设定为遵循指令或开放域间交流生成,而不是依次以故事为基础的续作。

blocks.en: 3 Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 3 问题定义

blocks.en: 3.1 Core Properties of Story-Grounded Omnimodal Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 故事组合式Omnimodule生成的核心属性

blocks.en:
We formulate omnimodal generation as story-grounded continuation. A storybook is represented as a multimodal page sequence 𝒮 = { s 1 , … , s N } \mathcal{S}=\{s_{1},\ldots,s_{N}\} , where each page s i = ( x i , t i , a i ) s_{i}=(x_{i},t_{i},a_{i}) consists of an image x i ∈ ℐ x_{i}\in\mathcal{I} , narration text t i ∈ 𝒯 t_{i}\in\mathcal{T} , and speech information a i ∈ 𝒜 a_{i}\in\mathcal{A} .
Given the current-page image x i x_{i} , narration t i t_{i} , book-level metadata, and expected next-page conditions, a model must generate the next page s i + 1 s_{i+1} as coordinated image, narration, and speech outputs describing the same narrative state.
blocks.zh:
我们设计了全方位模式,作为故事的延续。 故事本作为多模式页面序列S = {s 1, ..., s N }\ mathcal{S }=\{s_{1},\ ldots, s_{N}\} ,其中每页 s = (x i, t i, a i) s_{i}=(x_{i}, t_{i}, a_{i}) 包含一个图像 x i\\\\\\\\\ mathcal{I}, 描述文本 t i\\ t\\\\\\\\\\ mathcal{T}, 和语音信息 a i\\\ a\\\\\\\\\\ mathcal{A} 。
鉴于当前页面图像 xi x_{i}, 叙述 t i t_{i}, 书级元数据, 以及预期的下一页条件, 一个模型必须生成下一页 s + 1 s_{i+1} 作为协调图像, 叙述, 以及描述同一叙述状态的语音输出 。

blocks.en: For each transition ( s i → s i + 1 ) (s_{i}\rightarrow s_{i+1}) , a successful model should satisfy four core properties: 1. Contextual grounding: The generated outputs should reflect the current page, character information, and next-page conditions. 2. Narrative continuity: The outputs should preserve story flow across characters, events, actions, and emotions. 3. Modality-specific quality: Each modality should be individually plausible and appropriate for the storybook domain. 4. Cross-modal consistency: The generated image, narration, and speech should be mutually aligned in characters, actions, emotions, scene semantics, and spoken content.
blocks.zh: 对于每个过渡(s i → s i + 1) (s_{i}\rightarrow s_{i+1}),成功的模型应满足四个核心属性: 1. 背景情况: 生成的产出应反映当前页面、字符信息和下一页的条件。 2. 叙述连续性: 这些产出应保持故事在人物、事件、行动和情感之间的流动。 3. 特定模式的质量: 每种模式都应个别合理,适合故事书领域。 4. 跨模式一致性: 生成的图像,叙事,和语音,应该在人物,动作,情感,场景语义,和口语内容上相互配合.

blocks.en: Contextual grounding: The generated outputs should reflect the current page, character information, and next-page conditions.
blocks.zh: 环境定位: 生成的产出应反映当前页面、字符信息和下一页的条件。

blocks.en: Narrative continuity: The outputs should preserve story flow across characters, events, actions, and emotions.
blocks.zh: 叙述连续性: 这些产出应保持故事在人物、事件、行动和情感之间的流动。

blocks.en: Modality-specific quality: Each modality should be individually plausible and appropriate for the storybook domain.
blocks.zh: 特定模式的质量:每种模式都应个别合理,适合故事书领域。

blocks.en: Cross-modal consistency: The generated image, narration, and speech should be mutually aligned in characters, actions, emotions, scene semantics, and spoken content.
blocks.zh: 跨模式一致性: 生成的图像,叙事,和语音,应该在人物,动作,情感,场景语义,和口语内容上相互配合.

blocks.en:
These properties distinguish story-grounded omnimodal generation from separate image generation, text generation, and speech synthesis.
Even high-quality individual outputs fail as an omnimodal response if they contradict one another or do not coherently continue the story.

这些属性将故事基于的全模式生成与单独的图像生成,文本生成,和语音合成区分开来.
即使是高质量的个人产出,如果相互矛盾,或者不连贯地继续,也不能作为全方位反应。

blocks.en: 4 Omni-StoryBench: Benchmark for Omnimodal Generation
blocks.zh: 4 《Omni-Story Bench:模拟生成基准》

blocks.en:
Omni-StoryBench evaluates story-grounded omnimodal generation, assessing both the individual quality of image, narration, and speech and whether they form a coherent next-page continuation.
The dataset contains 900 samples. Each sample’s input comprises the current storybook page image, corresponding narration, and instructions to generate the next page. Given this input, models must generate the next-page image, corresponding narration, and a plausible speech utterance from a character in the scene. The following sections detail dataset construction and evaluation. Concrete examples are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
Omni-Story Bench评价了基于故事的全方位模式生成,既评估了图像,叙事,和语音的个体质量,也评估了它们是否构成了连贯的下一页续作.
数据集包含900个样本. 每个样本的投入包括当前的故事书页面图像、相应的叙述和生成下一页的指示。 基于这种投入,模型必须生成下一页的图像,相应的叙述,以及场景中某个角色的可信言论. 以下各节详细介绍了数据集的构建和评价。 具体例子见附录B。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设

blocks.en:
We collected children’s storybooks from four websites providing openly licensed materials, as detailed in Appendix C .
Each storybook has multiple pages, each with an illustration and corresponding narration.
From these sources, we extracted 91,449 candidate page transitions, with the current page as input and the next page as ground truth.
blocks.zh:
我们从四个网站收集儿童故事书,提供公开许可的材料,详见附录C。
每本故事书都有多页,每页都有插图和相应的叙述.
从这些来源中,我们提取了91,449个候选页面过渡,以当前页面作为输入,下一页作为地面真相.

blocks.en:
Because image-text page pairs alone are insufficient for controlled omnimodal evaluation, we augment each transition with three metadata types. Book-level metadata captures global story information including genre, topic, style, narrative perspective, and character profiles. Next-page conditions specify local generation constraints, including character emotions, visibility, actions, speech intent, scene information, text goals, and ambient sound. Speech content and metadata define the target spoken utterance and speaker attributes, including emotion, speed, pitch, and gender.
These metadata enable checking whether models generate the intended next page rather than an arbitrary plausible continuation.
blocks.zh:
由于光是图像文本页面配对不足以进行受控的全模式评价,所以我们用三种元数据类型来增强每一个过渡. 图书级元数据获取全球故事信息,包括流派,主题,风格,叙事视角,以及人物简介. 下一页的条件指定了本地生成的限制,包括人物情感,能见度,动作,语音意图,场景信息,文本目标,以及环境声音. 语音内容和元数据定义了目标口语和扬声器属性,包括情感,速度,投注和性别.
这些元数据能够检查模型是否生成了预期的下一页,而不是任意的、可信的延续。

blocks.en:
We annotated using large language and vision-language models.
Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) produces book-level metadata from each storybook’s full narration.
Qwen2.5-32B ( Yang et al., 2025b ) generates missing speech utterances and their metadata from the narration.
Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) infers next-page conditions from the current page, the ground-truth next page, and the book-level metadata.
An example appears in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用大型语言和视觉语言模型进行注释。
Qune3-32B(Yang等人,2025a)从每本故事书的完整叙述中产生书级元数据.
Wen2.5-32B(Yang等人,2025b)从叙述中生成缺失的语音语音及其元数据.
Quen3-VL-32B-Instruct (Bai et al., 2025)从当前页面推断下一页的条件,下一页的地面真相,以及书级元数据.
图8显示了一个例子。

blocks.en:
Many collected transitions are unsuitable for benchmarking due to weak page-to-page correlation, non-English text, extreme text length, or low-quality images.
We therefore applied three-phase quality control.
First, rule-based filters removed samples with excessively long outputs or multiple speech lines.
Second, GLM-4.6V-FP8 ( Hong et al., 2026 ) scored each candidate on current-page quality, next-page quality, image-style coherence, and transition coherence; we retained each book’s highest-scoring pair and selected the top 1,000 pairs overall.
Finally, 16 human reviewers inspected, filtered, and revised the selected pairs, yielding 900 examples.
Details are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
由于页面对页面的相关性薄弱,非英文文本,文本长度极小,或者图像质量低,许多收集的过渡不适合制定基准.
因此,我们实行了三阶段质量控制。
首先,基于规则的过滤器移除了输出过长或多个语音行的样本.
其次,GLM-4.6V-FP8(Hong等人,2026年)在当页质量,下一页质量,图像风格的一致性,以及过渡一致性方面给每位候选人打分;我们保留了每本书最高的得分对,并整体选择了1000对前.
最后,16名审查员检查、过滤和修改了选定的对子,产生了900个实例。
详情见附录D。

In Semi-orchestration , the backbone can only generate two out of the three modalities (text, image, and speech), so a separate expert module is connected to generate the remaining modality. Finally, Any-to-Any refers to an architecture where a single backbone model is capable of directly generating all three modalities.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Pipeline Design
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价管道设计

blocks.en: Evaluating omni-modal generation requires complementary methods. Traditional Automated Metrics provide reproducible measures of output fidelity ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Jung et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2023b ) , while LLM-as-a-Judge 1 1 1 LLM-judge scores are diagnostic rather than substitutes for human evaluation. Judge bias and speech-evaluation limitations are discussed in Appendix A . captures semantic, contextual, and cross-modal qualities through rubric-based judgments. We therefore use two evaluation categories. Details are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 评价所有模式的生成需要补充方法。 传统的自动化计量法提供了产出忠贞的可复制计量标准(Zhang等人,2020年;Jung等人,2025年;Fu等人,2023年b),而LLM-as-a-Judge 1 1 LLM-judge的分数是诊断性的,而不是人类评价的替代品。 附录A讨论了法官的偏见和言论评价限制。 因此,我们使用两个评价类别。 详情见附录E。

blocks.en: Traditional Automated Metrics. For text, image, and speech, we report BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) , CLIP Similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and Speech Metadata Accuracy, respectively. Speech Metadata Accuracy is the mean of four attribute-wise exact-match indicators—emotion, speed, pitch, and gender—against the ground-truth metadata.
blocks.zh: 传统自动计量. 关于文本、图像和言论,我们分别报告BERTScore(Zhang等人,2020年),CLIP相似性(Radford等人,2021年),和Speak Motheramia准确性。 语音元数据 准确性是四个属性精确匹配指标的平均值——情感、速度、投球和性别——对照地面真实元数据。

blocks.en:
LLM-as-a-Judge. We assign modality-specific and integrated 1–10 scores across four
categories: Metadata Alignment, Contextual Continuity, Generation Condition Compliance, and Ground-Truth Semantic Consistency . To reduce dependence on one judge backbone, we use three judges per evaluation type—text, image, speech, and integrated omnimodal evaluation—reporting the arithmetic mean of their corresponding scores. Judge models are listed in Appendix E.3 .

类别:元数据对齐、背景连续性、生成条件合规性和地语义一致性。 为了减少对一名法官骨干依赖,我们使用每类评价中的三名法官——文字、图像、言论和综合全方位评价——报告相应分数的算术平均值。 法官模型列于附录E.3。

Each main-text quality metric averages valid evaluator scores over examples with its required outputs available; integrated judging requires all three modalities. These scores measure quality conditional on output and valid-score availability, while Figure 4 reports generation reliability. Results scoring missing outputs as zero are in Appendix F.4 .

blocks.en: 5 Benchmarking Baseline Systems on Omni-StoryBench
blocks.zh: 5 《Omni-Story Bench基准系统》基准

blocks.en: We evaluate 32 omnimodal generation systems on Omni-StoryBench to assess their generation of coordinated image, text, and speech outputs for story-grounded continuation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Omni-Story Bench上的32个全模式生成系统,以评估其生成的协调图像、文字和语音产出,以继续故事。

blocks.en: 5.1 Baseline System Architectures
blocks.zh: 5.1 基线系统结构

blocks.en: We categorize approaches to omnimodal generation into three paradigms, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们将所有模式生成方法分为三个模式。

blocks.en: Orchestration. This paradigm combines separate modality-specific expert models in a pipeline. For orchestration, we used five vision–language model (VLM) backbones: three large-scale VLMs—GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-4.7 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , and GLM-4.6V (106B) ( Hong et al., 2026 ) —and two smaller VLMs—InternVL3.5-4B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Each backbone receives the current scene narration, current scene image, and generation conditions, and produces the next-scene narration text, a text-to-image prompt, and speech metadata; the latter two feed the image generator and TTS model to produce image and speech.
blocks.zh: 管弦乐. 这一范式将单独的模式特定专家模型结合到一个管道中. 在管弦乐方面,我们使用了五个视觉-语言模型(VLM)骨干:三个大型VLM-GPT-5.4(OpenAI,2026年),克劳德-奥普斯-4.7(Anthropic,2026年)和GLM-4.6V(106B)(Hong等人,2026年)——以及两个较小的VLM-. InternVL3.5-4B(Wang等人,2025年)和Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026年). 每个主干接收当前场景描述,当前场景图像,和生成条件,并生成下场描述文本,文本对图像的提示,以及语音元数据;后两个反馈图像生成器和TTS模型生成图像和语音.

blocks.en: Semi-orchestration. This approach combines a model jointly generating some target modalities with an expert for the remaining modality. For semi-orchestration, we used text–image backbones, MMaDA ( Yang et al., 2025c ) and Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and text–speech backbones, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025a ) and EMOVA-7B ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . These backbones generate assigned modalities, passing intermediate outputs to an image generator or TTS model for the remainder.
blocks.zh: 半截处. 这种办法将一种模式与一名专家联合生成一些目标模式。 对于半截断,我们使用了文本-图像骨干,MMADA(杨等人,2025c)和Emu3(王等人,2024),以及文本-speech骨干, Wen2.5-Omni-7B(徐等人,2025年a)和EMOVA-7B(陈等人,2025年a). 这些主干线产生指定模式,将中间输出传递给图像生成器或TTS模型供剩余部分使用.

blocks.en: Modality experts. For orchestration and semi-orchestration, we used FLUX.1-dev, FLUX.1-Kontext ( Labs et al., 2025 ) , and Nitro-T-1.2B ( Haridas et al., 2025 ) as external image generators. Since FLUX.1-Kontext can condition on an image and prompt, it lets us assess performance changes when the current scene image is added as input. For TTS, we selected metadata-conditioned Parler-large ( Lyth and King, 2024 ) and VoxCPM2 ( Team, 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 模式专家。 对于管弦乐和半管弦乐,我们使用了FLUX.1-dev,FLUX.1-Kontext(Labs等人,2025年),以及Nitro-T-1.2B(Haridas等人,2025年)作为外部图像生成器. 由于FLUX.1-Kontext可以以一个图像为条件并迅速,所以当当前场景图像被添加为输入时,它可以让我们评估性能变化. 对于TTS,我们选择了具备元数据条件的Parler大号(Lyth and King,2024年)和VoxCPM2(Team,2026年;周等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Any-to-any. This approach uses one backbone that can receive and generate all three target modalities, generally treating them as unified generation over a shared token or representation space. For any-to-any baselines, we used HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni ( NAVER Cloud HyperCLOVA X Team, 2026 ) , AnyGPT ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , Omni-Diffusion ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and Dynin-Omni ( Kim et al., 2026a ) . This capability should not be conflated with simultaneous three-modality generation in one inference pass: other any-to-any baselines were invoked separately per target modality, whereas, among these baselines, only Dynin-Omni generated text, image, and speech simultaneously in one inference pass.
blocks.zh: 随便你 这种方法使用一个能够接收和生成所有三种目标模式的骨干,一般将它们作为统一的一代,置于共享的代号或代表空间之上. 对于任何基准,我们使用HyperClOVA X 8B Omni(NAVER ClOVA X Team,2026年),AnyGPT(Zhan等人,2024年),Omni-Difusion. (Li et al., 2026a),和迪宁-奥姆尼(Kim et al., 2026a). 这种能力不应与一个推论中同时生成的三种模式混为一谈:其他任何基准都是按目标模式单独引用的,而在这些基准中,只有Dynin-Omni生成文字、图像和发言同时通过一个推论。

blocks.en: 5.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: On Omni-StoryBench, orchestration still leads, while semi-orchestration and any-to-any systems are limited by output quality and capacity to reliably, controllably generate all required modalities.
blocks.zh: 在Omni-Story Bench上,管弦乐仍然领先,而半管弦乐和任何对任意的系统则受到输出质量和可靠,可控生成所有所需模式的能力的限制.

blocks.en: Performance Gap. Figure 3 reports the total average score for each baseline across all metrics. The results indicate that current omnimodal and any-to-any generation models have yet to reach a stable developmental stage. The highest Total Average scores consistently occur in orchestration with large VLM backbones. However, this trend should not be attributed merely to VLM backbone scale. Even 4B-scale orchestration systems outperform most any-to-any and semi-orchestration baselines, suggesting that explicitly invoking modality-specific experts remains effective on Omni-StoryBench.
blocks.zh: 业绩差距:图3报告所有衡量标准每个基线的总平均分。 结果表明,目前的全方位模式和任何一代人模式尚未达到稳定的发展阶段。 最高的总平均分一直出现在与大型VLM主干线的编织中. 然而,不应将这一趋势仅仅归因于虚拟LM主干级。 即使4B级的管弦系统也比大多数任何对任何和半管弦基线都要好,这表明明确援引特定模式的专家在Omni-Story Bench上仍然有效。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Number of orchestration JSON errors and missing outputs per modality. A test case may contribute to multiple modality segments. Unlisted backbones have no recorded generation failures.
blocks.zh: 图4:按方式排列的JSON错误和缺失产出的数目。 测试案例可能有助于多种模式段。 未上市的骨干没有记录的生成失败.

blocks.en: Stability Gap. Separately from output quality, Figure 4 reports generation reliability. Any-to-any and semi-orchestration systems often leave generation incomplete or omit required modalities. In semi-orchestration systems using MMaDA, EMOVA-7B and Emu3-9B backbones, all three modalities have missing outputs. This suggests failures mainly stem from the backbone’s limited ability to reliably follow instructions and produce valid intermediate outputs for orchestrating modality-specific experts 2 2 2 We implement the orchestration interface using JSON, a common format for structured intermediate outputs ( Shen et al., 2023 ; Hyeon et al., 2026 ) . . In practice, these models often produce malformed intermediate outputs beyond simple rule-based correction, or omit fields required for downstream image or speech generation. Thus, the final response may lack image, narration, or speech despite available individual expert models. For Qwen2.5-Omni, failed second-pass planning leaves text and image missing in 11 cases, while first-pass speech remains available; Figure 4 therefore records both omission types.
blocks.zh: 稳定差距。 与产出质量分开,图4报告生成可靠性。 任何到任何系统以及半整流系统往往使生成不完全或省略所需的模式。 在使用MADA,EMOVA-7B和Emu3-9B主干线的半整流系统中,所有三种模式都有缺失的输出. 这表明失败主要来自骨干部门可靠地遵循指示和产生有效中间产出的能力有限,以安排特定方式的专家 2 2 我们使用结构化中间产出的通用格式JSON实施协调接口(Shen等人,2023年;Hyeon等人,2026年)。 在实践中,这些模型往往产生超出简单的基于规则的校正的畸形中间输出,或者省略下游图像或语音生成所需的字段. 因此,尽管有专家个人模型,但最后答复可能缺乏形象、叙述或言论。 对于Quen2.5-Omni,失败的二号通道规划在11个案例中留下文字和图像缺失,而第一号通道的演讲仍然可用;因此图4记录了两种省略类型.

blocks.en: Modality-generation failures also occur in any-to-any models. For example, Omni-Diffusion sometimes produces only text tokens, omitting required image or speech tokens, even when image or speech output is explicitly requested. For HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni, all image omissions result from responses lacking the narration needed for the image prompt, causing the pipeline to skip image generation. Speech is missing in 115 cases: 51 lack a parsed utterance, and 64 return no audio. In contrast, orchestration rarely exhibits such failures, even with small VLM backbones.
blocks.zh: 模式生成失败也出现在任何一种模式中。 例如,Omni-Difusion有时只产生文字符号,省略所需的图像或语音符号,即使明确要求图像或语音输出. 用于超CLOVA X 8B Omni,所有图像遗漏都是由于响应缺乏图像提示所需的描述,导致管道跳过图像生成. 115起案件的言论缺失:51起缺乏解析语,64起回无音频。 相比之下,管弦乐很少表现出这种失败,即使有小的VLM骨干.

blocks.en: These findings show that the performance gap concerns both output quality and whether a system can reliably produce all requested modalities.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,业绩差距既涉及产出质量,也涉及一个系统是否能够可靠地产生所有要求的模式。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: 6.1 Text Connects, Speech Correlates, but Image Bottlenecks
blocks.zh: 6.1 文本连接, 语音关联, 但图像 bottlenecks

blocks.en: Table 1: Pairwise Pearson correlations across modality scores for all baselines ( N = 32 N=32 ). Text and speech exhibit the strongest correlation.
blocks.zh: 表1:所有基线的平滑皮尔逊模式分数的相互关系(N=32 N=32)。 文字和演说表现出最强的关联性.

blocks.en: Table 2: Modality-bottleneck diagnostics across 32 evaluated systems. Bold marks the strongest diagnostic signal in each row.
blocks.zh: 表2:32个受评价系统的模式-瓶颈诊断。 粗体表示每行最强的诊断信号.

blocks.en:
Text, image, and speech scores are not independent. Across the 32 evaluated systems, modality-specific scores correlate strongly, more so for text–speech and text–image than image–speech (Table 1 ). Strong text performance is associated with other modalities’ performance, consistent with the role of story-state understanding,
condition parsing, and prompt construction in omnimodal generation. Among the three pairwise correlations in Table 1 , text–speech is strongest. This accompanies Figure 3 ’s trend: semi-orchestration systems pairing a text-speech backbone with an image generator outperform the opposite configuration pairing a text-image backbone with TTS. This comparison describes the evaluated configurations without isolating backbone architecture’s effect.
blocks.zh:
文本,图像,和语音分数都不独立. 在32个被评价的系统中,特定模式的得分关系密切,文本的得分比图像的得分更为密切(表1)。 强有力的文字表现与其他模式的表演有关,符合故事状态理解的作用,
条件解析,并在 imnimodule 生成中迅速构建 。 在表1的三个对偶的关联中,文本 - speech是最强的. 这与图3的趋势相伴:半导体系统将文本语音主干线与图像生成器对齐,将文本图像主干线与TTS对齐的相反配置比对. 这种比较描述了评价的配置,而不孤立主干结构的效果。

blocks.en: High correlation alone does not reveal the greatest modality imbalance. Table 2 reports four diagnostics across all 32 systems: weakest-modality count measures how often a modality is relatively weakest; mean weakest-modality rank gap measures how far it trails the other two in within-modality rank; IQR summarizes score dispersion; and Max Total (Bottom Tercile) gives the highest observed total among systems weak in that modality. Image has the highest weakest count (14), largest mean rank gap (6.85 percentage points), widest IQR (1.79), and lowest bottom-tercile maximum (6.60), making it the clearest observed bottleneck. Appendix E.6 provides definitions, design rationale, and sensitivity checks.
blocks.zh: 高相关性本身并不显示最大的模式不平衡。 表2报告所有32个系统中的4项诊断:最弱模式计数方法衡量一种模式的相对最弱程度;平均最弱模式在模式内排位差距衡量其他两种模式的足迹;国际质量评估总结了分数分散情况;Max Total(Bottom Tercile)在模式薄弱的系统中观测到的总数最高。 图像拥有最高最弱的数(14),最大平均军衔差(6.85个百分点),最宽的IQR(1.79),以及最低的底土最高(6.60),使其成为观察到的最明显的瓶颈. 附录E.6提供了定义、设计原理和敏感性检查。

blocks.en:
Table 3: Partial correlations across all baselines ( N = 32 N=32 ).
Bold indicates p < 0.05 p<0.05 .
blocks.zh:
表3:所有基线的部分关联性(N=32N=32)。
粗体表示p < 0.05 p < 0.05。

blocks.en: Table 4: Partial correlations within semi-orchestration and any-to-any baselines ( N = 14 N=14 ).
blocks.zh: 表4:半曲线和任何对任意基线中的部分相关性(N=14N=14)。

blocks.en: To examine associations controlling for the third modality, we compute partial correlations in Tables 3 and 4 . Across all configurations, the image–speech partial correlation controlling for text is small ( r = − 0.122 r=-0.122 ), whereas text–image and text–speech retain positive partial correlations ( r = 0.626 r=0.626 and r = 0.758 r=0.758 , respectively). The exploratory semi-orchestration and any-to-any subset ( N = 14 N=14 ) shows a similar pattern, with text–speech exhibiting the strongest residual association ( r = 0.748 r=0.748 ). These associations describe the evaluated configurations; shared backbones and expert modules limit the interpretation of nominal p-values based on independent-configuration assumptions. Separately, Table 2 shows that configurations in the bottom tercile of image performance have a lower maximum Total Average than those in the bottom tercile of text or speech performance. Integrated evaluation averaged across three judges also retains positive partial correlations with text and image scores after controlling for the other modalities (Appendix F.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了审查控制第三种方式的社团,我们计算表3和表4中的部分关联。 在所有配置中,图像 — speech 部分对文本的关联性控制是小的(r = − 0.122 r = - 0.122),而文本 — 图像和文本 — speech 保留正部分关联性(r = 0.626 r = 0.626,r = 0.758 r = 0.758)。 探索性半导体和任意子集(N = 14 N = 14 ) 显示了类似的模式,文本 — — 语音显示最强的剩余关联(r = 0.748 r= 0.748 ) 。 这些关联描述了评估的配置;共享骨干和专家模块限制了基于独立配置假设的名义p值的解释。 另外,表2显示,图像性能下方的配置最大总平均值低于文本或语音性能下方的配置。 3名法官的平均综合评价在控制其他模式后,还保留了与文本和图像分数的正比关系(附录F.3)。

blocks.en: 6.2 The Verbosity Trap in Orchestration
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 管弦乐中的空洞陷阱

blocks.en: Figure 5: Comparison of Text Evaluation Metrics. Large-VLM orchestration scores highly under LLM judging, but shows smaller gains in BERTScore.
blocks.zh: 图5:文本评价计量比较. 大型VLM管弦乐在LLM判断下得分很高,但在BERTScore中显示得分较小.

blocks.en: For text, orchestration scores highly on LLM-judge metadata alignment, generation-condition satisfaction, and semantic consistency. However, this advantage is less pronounced under BERTScore (Figure 5 ): its margin over baselines including Omni-Diffusion and MMaDA remains relatively small. This discrepancy is consistent with large-VLM orchestration’s verbosity-induced over-specification.
blocks.zh: 就文字而言,管弦乐在LLM评断元数据对齐,生成条件满意度,语义一致性方面评分很高. 然而,在BERTScore(图5)中,这一优势并不明显:它在基线(包括Omni-Difcuation和MMADA)上的比值仍然相对较小。 这种差异与大VLM编组的动词引起的超规格一致。

blocks.en:
While Omni-StoryBench’s ground-truth text is typically short, direct, literary, and aligned with children’s fairy-tale style, orchestration often adds unnecessary scene details, character states, or explanatory phrases.
Although these additions may be semantically plausible and favored by LLM judges, they fit the concise narrative context less well and yield only modest BERTScore gains.
blocks.zh:
虽然Omni-Story Bench的地面真言文本通常很短、直接、文学,并符合儿童的童话风格,但管弦乐往往会增加不必要的场景细节、人物状态或解释性词语。
虽然这些增加可能令人信服,并得到LLM法官的青睐,但它们不太适合简明的叙述背景,只能产生有限的BERTScore收益。

blocks.en:
Most orchestration-generated texts with high LLM-judge text scores are therefore substantially longer than the ground truth, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
For example, while the ground-truth text averages 107 characters, large VLMs such as Claude-Opus-4.7, GPT-5.4, and GLM-4.6V generate outputs averaging over 200 characters. These verbose outputs receive high LLM-judge scores but show only modest BERTScore gains, exposing a mismatch between rubric-based success and reference-based similarity to the concise ground-truth narration. This result suggests that even current state-of-the-art LLMs do not fully internalize the stylistic prior required for fairy-tale continuation: narration that is short, clear, and appropriate for children’s books. Appendix F.1 and Table 30 provide detailed results.
blocks.zh:
因此,如图1所示,大多数由LLM评分高的编织文本比基本事实要长得多。
例如,虽然地面真实文本平均为107个字符,但Claude-Opus-4.7、GPT-5.4和GLM-4.6V等大型VLM生成平均超过200个字符的输出。 这些动词产出获得高的LLM评分,但显示的BERTScore收益不大,暴露出基于主题的成功与基于参考的类似简洁的地面真实叙述之间的不匹配。 这一结果表明,即使是目前最先进的法学硕士,也不能完全内化童话继续所需的先行风格:简短、清晰和适合儿童书籍的叙述。 附录F.1和表30提供了详细结果。

blocks.en: 6.3 Plausible Images Still Break Continuity
blocks.zh: 6.3 仍然断裂的可显示图像

blocks.en: Figure 6: Image LLM-judge scores by category and baseline paradigm.
blocks.zh: 图6:按类别和基线模式分列的图像LLM评分。

blocks.en: As shown in the image-judge category scores in Figure 6 , metadata alignment remains relatively high, whereas visual and narrative continuity, condition satisfaction, and semantic consistency are substantially lower. This suggests that the main visual bottleneck is not generic image plausibility, but visual state preservation: baseline systems can often capture high-level metadata, yet fail to maintain the story’s concrete visual state across page transitions, including character appearance, spatial layout, object configuration, actions, and scene composition. The consistent advantage of FLUX.1-Kontext over FLUX.1-dev in Figure 3 further supports this interpretation. Because FLUX.1-Kontext has access to the current image, it can better preserve visual continuity with the previous scene, whereas compressing the story state into text alone loses visual information needed for next-scene generation.
blocks.zh: 如图6中图像判断类分数所示,元数据对齐率仍然较高,而视觉和叙事连续性、条件满意度和语义一致性则低得多。 这表明主要的视觉瓶颈并不是通用图像的可信度,而是视觉状态的保存:基线系统往往可以捕捉高层次元数据,但未能在页面过渡中保持故事的具体视觉状态,包括人物外观,空间布局,物体配置,动作,场景组成. FLUX.1-Kontext在图3中相对于FLUX.1-dev的一贯优势进一步支持这一解释. 由于FLUX.1-Kontext可以访问当前图像,因此它可以更好地保持与之前场景的视觉连续性,而将故事状态压缩成文本本身则会失去下一代所需的视觉信息.

blocks.en: 6.4 Implications and Future Directions for Native Omnimodal Models
blocks.zh: 6.4 对原生模式的影响和未来方向

blocks.en:
Although currently most reliable on Omni-StoryBench, orchestration incurs system-level costs:
separate model calls for text, image, and speech generation, design choices for intermediate
coordination, and multiple modality-specific experts controlled by a strong backbone. These
limitations motivate native any-to-any models that can generate coordinated multimodal outputs via a unified interface.
blocks.zh:
虽然目前在Omni-Story Bench上最可靠,但管弦乐会产生系统层面的成本:
单独的模型要求文本、图像和语音生成、中间的设计选择
协调,以及由强大的骨干所控制的多种模式特定专家。 这些
限制激励着任何能够通过统一接口产生协调的多式联运产出的原生模式。

blocks.en:
Our results suggest this direction is promising but not yet a complete orchestration substitute.
As shown in Figure 3 , excluding large-scale orchestration, the performance ranges of native any-to-any models, semi-orchestration systems, and small-backbone orchestration systems overlap. Dynin-Omni is especially informative, scoring competitively with small-backbone orchestration systems while generating all three modalities in one inference pass. This demonstrates that competitive performance is possible with native omnimodal generation in the evaluated setting. These results motivate further development of native models that achieve orchestration-level completeness, controllability, and modality-specific fidelity through a unified generation interface. Whether this interface also yields end-to-end efficiency gains requires direct cost and latency measurements.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,这一方向是很有希望的,但还不是完全有条理的替代。
如图3所示,不包括大规模管弦乐,本土任意型号的性能范围,半管弦乐系统,以及小背骨管弦乐系统重叠. 迪宁-奥姆尼尤其具有丰富的素材,与小背骨管弦系统竞争得分,同时在一个推论中生成所有三种模式. 这表明,在经过评价的环境下,在本地所有模式生成的情况下,竞争业绩是可能的。 这些成果促使通过统一的生成界面,进一步发展本土模式,实现管弦层面的完整性、可控性以及模式特有的忠诚。 这种接口是否还能产生端到端效率的提高,需要直接的成本和耐久性测量.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Omni-StoryBench evaluates whether omnimodal systems can continue a story coherently across
image, narration, and speech. Built from rigorously validated story transitions, the benchmark
combines modality-specific automatic metrics with LLM-judge rubrics for context preservation,
condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Our evaluation of 32
systems shows current native omnimodal generation remains far from solved: orchestration
pipelines with strong VLM planning are most reliable, while native any-to-any models still face
incomplete outputs, limited controllability, and weak visual state preservation. Within
story-grounded, condition-controlled continuation, observed failures motivate improvements in
cross-modal planning, visual-state preservation, and complete, mutually consistent realization
of requested outputs.
blocks.zh:
Omni-Story Bench 评估全方位系统能否连贯地延续一个故事
形象、叙事和言论。 由经过严格验证的故事过渡构成,基准
将特定模式的自动计量标准与LLM判断值组合起来,用于上下文保护,
遵循的条件、参考的一致性和跨模式的一致性。 我们评价32
系统显示当前本地所有模式的生成远未解决:
具有强大VLM规划的输油管最可靠,而当地的任何型号仍然面临
输出不完整,可控性有限,视觉状态保护薄弱. 内部
以故事为根据、以条件为控的延续、观察到的失败促使改进
跨模式规划、视觉状态保护以及完整、一致的实现
产出。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: Generative AI was used to construct the dataset’s annotation layer: book-level metadata, structured next-page conditions, speech attributes, and missing character utterances. A vision-language model scored candidate page transitions for quality-based selection. The source illustrations and narration came from existing storybook collections. Sixteen human reviewers inspected and filtered the selected candidates and reviewed and revised their annotations, yielding the final 900-example benchmark.
blocks.zh: Generative AI被用于构建数据集的注释层:书级元数据,结构化的下一页条件,语音属性,以及缺失的字符表达. 一个视觉语言模型为基于质量的筛选而给候选页面转换打分. 来源插图和叙事来自现有的故事书集. 16名人力资源审查员检查和筛选了选定的候选人,审查和修改了他们的说明,得出了900个实例的最后基准。

blocks.en: AI models were also used for baseline generation and automated evaluation, including model judges and speech-metadata classification. Generative AI supported feedback on experimental design, implementation, statistical verification, figure preparation, and language revision. The authors reviewed the resulting code and text, recalculated the reported statistics using saved outputs, and checked the cited sources. The authors take responsibility for the final content, annotations, and artifacts of this work.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The benchmark uses publicly available children’s storybooks with source-specific licensing conditions; provenance and attribution should accompany any redistributed material. Its English-language, selected storybook domain and uneven source distribution limit the populations and settings represented. Human review reduces but does not eliminate annotation errors. Voice-based apparent-gender labels are a restricted binary annotation convention and do not represent gender identity. Automated judgments may encode shared biases or encourage optimization for the evaluator; multi-family judges and independent human ratings provide complementary, limited checks. The human evaluation used a Label Studio interface shared online to collect rubric-based assessments of model outputs.
blocks.zh: 该基准使用公开提供的儿童故事书,并附有特定来源的许可证条件;任何重新分配的材料都应附有来源和归属。 其英语,部分故事书域和不均匀的来源分布限制了所代表的人口和设置. 人文审查减少但不消除注释错误. 基于语音的显性性别标签是一种限制性的二进制注释公约,并不代表性别认同. 自动判断可以编码共同的偏见,或鼓励评价人员优化;多家庭法官和独立的人的评级提供了补充性的有限检查。 人类评价使用Label Studio在线共享的界面,收集模型产出的基于数字的评估。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Modality-wise LLM-judge score distributions, averaged over three judges per modality.
blocks.zh: 图7:按模式排列的LLM法官评分分布,平均每模式有三名法官。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 7 , speech LLM-judge scores vary less across baselines than the corresponding text and image scores. This result suggests two possible interpretations. First, because the speech utterances generated in the current benchmark are relatively short and the metadata that must be directly reflected in speech is limited, the actual gap between expert TTS systems and omnimodal speech generation models may be small. Second, such differences may exist, but the speech LLM-judge scores across Audio Flamingo Next ( Ghosh et al., 2026 ) , MOSS-Audio-8B ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and Kimi-Audio-7B ( KimiTeam et al., 2025 ) may not be sufficiently discriminative to separate fine-grained differences in emotion, prosody, persona matching, and conversational nuance. This may reflect limitations in the speech judges’ capacity, training distributions, or rubric sensitivity. The averaged score distribution alone cannot distinguish these explanations or establish perceptual parity. The independent human study also shows weaker speech agreement than in the other tracks (Appendix F.5 ), while the inter-judge analysis reveals substantial speech-score disagreement (Appendix F.6 ). We therefore treat small speech-score differences as a secondary signal under this protocol. Longer utterances, finer prosody and persona rubrics, and dedicated listening studies are directions for improving discrimination. Ultimately, this highlights a direction for the field: the need for more active research toward scaling up speech foundation models to achieve highly discriminative speech comprehension.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,语音LLM评委的分数在基线上的差异小于相应的文字和图像分数. 这一结果提出了两种可能的解释。 首先,由于当前基准中生成的语音语句相对较短,且语音中必须直接反映的元数据有限,专家TTS系统与全模式语音生成模型之间的实际差距可能很小. 第二,这种差异可能存在,但演讲LLM评分在Audio Flamingo Next(Ghosh等人,2026年),MOSS-Audio-8B(Yang等人,2026年)和Kimi-Audio-7B(KimiTeam等人,2025年)的分数上可能不足以区分情感、亲切性、个人匹配和对话细微差别。 这可能反映出演讲法官的能力、培训分布或语言敏感性方面的限制。 平均得分分配单靠这些解释无法区分,也无法确立观念对等. 独立的人类研究也显示语音协议弱于其他音轨(Appendix F.5 ),而法官间分析则揭示了实质性的语音分数分歧(Appendix F.6 ). 因此,我们根据这项议定书,将小的言论分数差异视为次要信号。 更长的言论、更精细的发音和个性化语言,以及专门的倾听研究是改进歧视的方向。 归根结底,这突出了该领域的一个方向:需要更积极的研究,以扩大语音基础模型,实现高度歧视性的语音理解。

blocks.en: To complement the speech LLM-judge scores, we additionally built an evaluation module that extracts metadata from the generated speech and measures exact-match accuracy against the target metadata; see Table 31 . The results show that, in speech generation, gender is generally reflected most accurately, followed by speed, pitch, and emotion. This suggests that emotion is a more subjective attribute than gender, speed, or pitch, and that it depends on more fine-grained prosodic cues. This observation is also consistent with prior findings that emotion rendering and fine-grained emotion control remain challenging in emotional TTS ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Inoue et al., 2024 ; Cho et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了补充语音LLM评分,我们还建立了一个评价模块,从生成的语音中提取元数据,并对照目标元数据衡量精确匹配的准确性;见表31。 结果表明,在语音生成中,性别一般得到最准确的反映,其次是速度、投球和情感。 这表明情感比性别,速度,或投球更主观的属性,它依赖于更多精细的prosodic提示. 这一观察也与之前的发现一致,即情感渲染和精致的情感控制在情感TTS中依然具有挑战性(Liu等人,2021年;Inoue等人,2024年;Cho等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
A broader limitation of our evaluation is that LLM-as-a-judge itself may introduce model-specific biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . To reduce reliance on any single judge, we average scores from three judge backbones for each evaluation type: text, image, speech, and integrated omnimodal evaluation. However, averaging alone does not rule out shared biases or guarantee agreement with human judgments. System rankings and category-level trends may still depend on the
selected judges, their training distributions, and rubric sensitivity. We separately quantify agreement across the three judge panels in Appendix F.6 ; strong system-ranking correlations coexist with substantial score-calibration differences, especially for speech. We assess agreement between LLM-judge scores and human judgments in Appendix F.5 . The observed agreement reflects the judgments of the recruited participants under our evaluation protocol and may not generalize to broader populations.
blocks.zh:
我们评价的一个更广泛的局限是,LLM-as-a-judge本身可能引入特定模式的偏差(Zheng等人,2023年;Kim等人,2026年b;Ye等人,2025年)。 为了减少对任何单一法官的依赖,我们从每个评价类型的三个法官骨干平均得分:文本、图像、言论和综合全方位评价。 然而,光是平均并不能排除共同的偏见或保证与人的判决一致。 系统的排名和类别一级的趋势仍可能取决于
选定法官、其培训分布情况和主题敏感性。 我们在附录F.6中分别量化三个法官小组的一致意见;强有力的系统级关联与实质性的分数校准差异并存,特别是就言论而言。 我们评估LLM法官的分数与附录F.5中的人类判决之间的协议。 所遵守的协议反映了根据我们的评估程序被招募的参与者所作的判断,可能不会向更广泛的民众普遍适用。

blocks.en: The benchmark is limited to children’s storybooks and has an uneven source distribution. The selected, English-language storybook transitions do not establish performance on other languages, genres, or unrestricted real-world multimodal interaction. Publicly available source material may overlap model training data. Speech metadata evaluation uses coarse labels, including binary apparent-gender labels. Scores and rankings may depend on metric scaling, aggregation choices, evaluator coverage, and shared judge biases.

blocks.en: Appendix C Source of Omni-StoryBench
blocks.zh: 附录C Omni-Story Bench的来源

blocks.en:
Omni-StoryBench was constructed from publicly available children’s storybook collections.
We selected sources that provide illustrated storybooks with page-level text and permissive or clearly stated licenses.
The dataset was collected from four sources: African Storybook, Global Digital Library, Storybooks Canada, and Storyweaver.
From these sources, we first obtained 91,449 page-level input-output pairs, where each pair consists of a current page and its corresponding next page. Each benchmark sample is a two-page transition window, not a complete book. Across the 1,800 page narrations, the median page contains 17 whitespace-delimited words and two sentences, and 38.0% of pages contain at least three sentences. A two-page window contains a median of 36 words and four sentences. These statistics describe the source-page units retained by the benchmark; the speech reference is a separate target utterance with speaker information and four scored attributes.
blocks.zh:
Omni-Story Bench是根据公开发行的儿童故事书集而建的。
我们选择了提供附有页面文本和许可或明确许可的插图故事书的来源。
该数据集来自四个来源:非洲故事书、全球数字图书馆、加拿大故事书和故事织造者。
从这些来源,我们首先获得了91,449页级输入输出对子,其中每对由当前一页及其相应的下一页组成. 每个基准样本是两页的过渡窗口,而不是完整的书本. 通过1800页的描述,中位页包含17个白空限字和两句,38.0%的页面包含至少三句. 两页窗口包含36字和4句的中位数. 这些统计数据描述了基准保留的源页单位;语音参考是单独的目标语句,带有扬声器信息和四个得分属性.

blocks.en: We distinguish the publicly available source pages from the task annotations created during benchmark construction. The current-page illustrations and narration, as well as the next-page references, originate from the four storybook collections. Book metadata, structured next-page conditions, speech attributes, and missing character utterances were generated and human-verified for this benchmark. These task annotations were not available as an Omni-StoryBench annotation layer before its construction; this temporal distinction does not establish that every evaluated model was trained before the annotations became available. Nor does it establish that the underlying stories were absent from pretraining or post-training. We therefore make no claim that all evaluated models are free of benchmark exposure. Source-page memorization alone does not establish successful realization of the structured conditions and consistency across all three generated modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们把公开的源页与基准构建过程中创建的任务说明区分开来. 本页插图和叙事以及下一页的参考文献来源于四本故事集. 书本元数据、结构化的下页条件、语音属性和缺失的字符表达方式被生成出来,并为这一基准进行了人验证。 这些任务说明在构建前没有作为Omni-Story Bench注解层提供;这种时间上的区分并不能确定每个被评价的模型在说明发布前都经过了培训. 它也没有确定在培训前或培训后没有说明基本情况。 因此,我们没有声称所有评估的模型都没有基准暴露。 仅凭源页记忆并不能成功实现结构化条件和所有三种生成模式的一致性。

blocks.en: We audited the 900-instance benchmark to characterize the annotation layer. Counting normalized words in the current narration, topic, scene, narration instruction, ambient-sound description, and character-condition values, annotations account for 83.2% of input words on average across instances (82.1% when pooling all words). These percentages describe this specified textual field set, not multimodal information content or the share of the entire model prompt. All 900 normalized condition texts are distinct. Across the audited descriptive fields—scene, narration instruction, topic, ambient sound, character action, and speech intent—we found no shared contiguous eight-word span with the 1,798 pages outside each instance’s own transition. This test excludes the two pages in that transition and forms spans within individual fields. Against the corresponding next-page narration, the longest shared condition span has a median of two words; six instances (0.7%) share at least eight words. On average, 48.9% of ground-truth content-word tokens are absent from the condition, under the audit’s fixed stopword and numeric-token exclusions. These string-level results characterize lexical overlap; they do not prove an absence of semantic leakage or prior model exposure. In particular, short fields can have no eight-word span, and some target speech utterances quote the source dialogue.
blocks.zh: 我们审计了900英寸的基准 来描述注释层 在当前描述、主题、场景、描述指示、环境声音描述和字符条件值中计算规范化的单词,注释平均占各个实例输入单词的83.2%(集合所有单词时为82.1%)。 这些百分比描述的是这一指定的文本字段集,而不是多式联运信息内容或整个模型中所占的份额。 所有900份正常化条件文本都是不同的。 在经过审计的描述性领域——场景、叙述性指导、主题、环境声音、性格动作和言论意图——我们发现没有共同的毗连八字的跨度,每个案例本身过渡之外的1,798页。 这一测试排除了该过渡中的两页内容,形式跨越各个领域。 对照对应的下一页描述,最长的共享条件跨度为两个字的中位数;六个实例(0.7%)至少共有八个字. 平均来说,48.9%的地面真实内容字符号没有出现在条件中,根据审计的固定句子和数字化排除。 这些字符串级的结果是词汇重叠的特征;它们不能证明没有语义泄漏或以前的模型暴露。 特别是,短字字段不能有8个字的跨度,一些目标语句引用了源对话.

blocks.en: An internal text n-gram and perceptual-hash audit identified 50 candidate republication or adaptation clusters involving 112 of the 900 transitions (12.4%). Using their sample identifiers, we excluded all 112 flagged transitions and recomputed the current results on the remaining 788 transitions. We preserved the main aggregation: a valid-only mean for each judge, an equal mean over the three judges per track, independent valid-only automatic-metric means, and the same seven-component Total Average. The 32-configuration ranking is unchanged (Spearman ρ = 1.000 \rho=1.000 , Kendall τ = 1.000 \tau=1.000 , no rank moves); the largest absolute Total Average change is 0.027 on the 0–10 scale. This tests sensitivity to the identified internal duplicate set, not overlap with an external training corpus, and cannot detect exposure that benefits systems similarly.
blocks.zh: 一项内部正文和概念值审计确定了50个候选共和国或适应集群,涉及900个过渡中的112个(12.4%)。 我们利用他们的抽样识别资料,排除了所有112个标注的过渡,并重算了其余788个过渡的现有结果。 我们保留了主要的汇总:每个法官只有有效的平均值,每轨三名法官有平等的平均值,独立的只有有效的自动计量手段,以及同样的七部分的总平均值。 32配置排名不变(Spearman $ = 1.000\rho = 1.000,Kendall = 1.000\tau = 1.000,无等级变动);0–10等级表中最大绝对总变动为0.027. 这种测试对已查明的内部重复包的敏感性,而不是与外部培训包的重叠,无法检测对系统同样有益的暴露。

blocks.en: Verifying source-level training exclusion requires access to the actual training corpora and relevant checkpoint provenance. The benchmark-internal audits above cannot provide that verification. The release will include the duplicate-cluster annotations and a versioned per-instance fingerprint manifest with normalized-text and image-byte SHA-256 hashes and word eight-gram sketches for independent overlap checks. Exact hashes and lexical sketches have limited recall for paraphrases and transformed images; a missing match is not evidence of non-exposure. Source availability and licensing likewise do not establish whether a model used the material in training.
blocks.zh: 核实源一级培训的排除情况需要获得实际培训单位和相关检查站的出处。 上述基准内部审计无法提供这种核查。 发布内容将包括重复的集群说明和带有普通文字和图像字节SHA-256散列和八克字草图的版本逐字指纹,用于独立重叠检查. 精确的散列和词典草图对解说和变形图像的召回有限;缺失的匹配不是不曝光的证据. 同样,来源和许可证的提供也没有确定某一模式是否在培训中使用了这些材料。

blocks.en: The three-stage procedure first removes unsuitable transitions using rules on output length and speech-line structure, then ranks candidates using current-page quality, next-page quality, image-style coherence, and transition coherence. blocks.en: Appendix E Details of Evaluation

blocks.en: This appendix describes the evaluation protocol used for Omni-StoryBench. Each test example provides the current story context, a structured next-page condition, and ground-truth references for the next narration, next image, and target speech metadata. A generated response is evaluated using traditional modality-specific metrics, modality-specific LLM-as-a-judge scores, and an integrated omnimodal LLM-as-a-judge score. Speech metadata extraction is used to compute the speech accuracy metric. For availability-conditioned evaluation, examples lacking the outputs required by a metric are excluded from that metric’s denominator; records without valid evaluator scores are also excluded. Integrated judging requires all three modalities. Missing outputs are assigned zero only in the complementary zero-filled evaluation (See Appendix F.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍Omni-Story Bench所使用的评价协议. 每个测试示例都提供了当前的故事背景,结构化的下一页条件,以及下一次描述,下一张图像,和目标语音元数据的地面真实参考. 利用传统模式特定度量衡、模式特定LLM-as-a-judge分数和综合全方位LLM-as-a-judge分数来评价生成的答复。 语音元数据提取用于计算语音精度度度量. 对于具备条件的评价,没有衡量标准所要求的产出的例子不包括在该衡量标准的分母中;没有有效评价分数的记录也不包括。 综合判断需要所有三种模式。 缺失的产出仅在补充性零填充评价中指定为零(见附录F.4)。

blocks.en: E.2 Speech Metadata Extraction
blocks.zh: E.2 语音元数据提取

blocks.en: Speech metadata accuracy requires a separate classifier that predicts metadata from generated audio. For emotion, apparent gender, and acoustic prosody analysis, the waveform is loaded with librosa , converted to mono, resampled to 16 kHz, and silence-trimmed with a 30 dB threshold. Transcription is performed separately by passing the original audio path to the openai/whisper-large-v3 ASR pipeline with word timestamps. The transcript is used for speed estimation and diagnostics; its text is not part of the four-field exact-match score.
blocks.zh: 语音元数据精度需要单独的分类器,从生成的音频中预测元数据. 对于情感,明显的性别,和声波的亲子分析,波形上装有librosa ,转换为单体,重印为16 kHz,并用30 dB的阈值进行静态刻度. Transcription通过将原始的音频路径传递到Openai/Whisper-large-v3 ASR管道,并带有文字时间戳来单独进行. 笔录用于速度估计和诊断;其文字不属于四野精确比分.

blocks.en: The default emotion backend is an equal-weight ensemble of three audio emotion recognizers: SpeechBrain emotion-recognition-wav2vec2-IEMOCAP , superb/hubert-large-superb-er , and iic/emotion2vec_plus_large . Model-specific labels are canonicalized into neutral , happy , sad , and angry . The normalized probability distributions are averaged, and the highest-probability canonical label is selected.
blocks.zh: 默认的情感后端是一个由三个音频情感识别器组成的等重的组合: (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). SpeechBrain Elities - Administration - Wav2vec2-IEMOCAP, Superb/hubert - 大超人 - er, and iic/emotion 2vec_plus_ great. 模式性标签被冠以中性、快乐、悲伤和愤怒。 常态概率分布是平均的,选择了最高概率的犬科标签.

blocks.en: Apparent speaker gender is predicted with audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender . The audio is evaluated in 3.0-second windows with a 1.5-second hop. Female, male, and child probabilities are averaged across windows, and the final benchmark label is binarized to female or male by comparing the averaged female and male probabilities.
blocks.zh: 男性与男性的性格不同, 音频在3.0秒的窗口中以1.5秒的hop评价. 女性,男性,以及孩子的概率通过窗口进行平均比对,最终的基准标签通过比较女性和男性的平均概率来比对女性或男性.

blocks.en: Speaking speed is measured as timestamped Whisper word chunks per second. If word timestamps are unavailable, the classifier falls back to a token-like transcript count divided by energy-based speech duration. The thresholds are 2.6 and 4.7 units per second: below 2.6 is slow , above 4.7 is fast , and the interval between them is normal .
blocks.zh: 说话速度以每秒时标的Whisper单词块表示。 如果文字时间戳不可用,分类器会回到像符号的语句计数器除以能量的语音时间. 阈值为2.6和4.7单位每秒:2.6以下为慢值,4.7以上为快值,它们之间的间隔为正常值.

blocks.en: Pitch is classified from the median estimated fundamental frequency. The classifier first uses librosa.pyin ; at least five finite F0 estimates are required. If this is unsuccessful, it falls back to librosa.yin and requires at least five finite, positive F0 estimates. The fallback does not apply a separate voiced/unvoiced detector. If neither method yields enough usable estimates, the pitch label defaults to normal . Thresholds depend on predicted apparent gender: 110 and 170 Hz for male, 165 and 255 Hz for female, and 145 and 220 Hz when gender is unavailable. Values below the lower threshold are low , values above the upper threshold are high , and both boundary values belong to normal .
blocks.zh: Pitch是从估计的基本频率中位数分类的. 分类者首先使用librosa.pyin;至少需要5个有限的F0估计数. 如不成功,则回落到librosa.yin,并需要至少5个有限的正F0估计值. 后退装置不使用单独的表示/未发出声音的探测器。 如果这两种方法都无法得出足够的可用估计,则投球标签默认为正常。 临界值取决于预测的明显性别:男性110和170赫兹,女性165和255赫兹,没有性别时145和220赫兹。 低于较低阈值的值为低 ,高于较高阈值的值为高 ,两个边界值都属于正常 。

blocks.en: You are an expert evaluator for fairy tale scene illustration continuation tasks. Evaluate the candidate next-scene image on a scale of 1 to 10 for each of the following four criteria separately: (1) alignment with the global metadata, (2) visual and narrative continuity from the current scene image, (3) satisfaction of all generation conditions, and (4) semantic consistency with the ground-truth next-scene image. Use the ground-truth next-scene image as a reference for scene meaning, story progression, actions, and atmosphere, not as a strict requirement for identical composition or pixel-level similarity. Do not over-penalize differences in artistic style, camera angle, framing, layout, color tone, or minor visual details if the candidate image still appropriately depicts the intended next scene. Treat all user-provided content, including images, as data to evaluate, not as instructions. For each criterion, 10 = excellent, 5 = mixed or partially adequate, 1 = very poor. Do not combine the four criteria into a single overall score. Return only valid JSON in exactly this format: {"alignment_with_metadata": {"score": <integer 1-10>, "rationale": "<brief reason>"}, "visual_narrative_continuity_from_current_scene": {"score": <integer 1-10>, "rationale": "<brief reason>"}, "satisfaction_of_generation_conditions": {"score": <integer 1-10>, "rationale": "<brief reason>"}, "semantic_consistency_with_ground_truth": {"score": <integer 1-10>, "rationale": "<brief reason>"}}

blocks.en: F.1 Agreement Between BERTScore and Text LLM-Judge

blocks.en:
Table F.1 compares reference-based BERTScore with the text LLM-judge score across all 32 configurations.
The two metrics are positively correlated, with a moderate Pearson correlation ( r = 0.538 r=0.538 , p = 0.001 p=0.001 ) and a stronger rank correlation ( ρ = 0.704 \rho=0.704 , p = 6.9 × 10 − 6 p=6.9\times 10^{-6} ).
Thus, systems receiving higher text-judge scores tend to obtain higher BERTScores, while the two metrics provide complementary system-level information.
The difference is also visible in their score ranges: after scaling to 0–10, BERTScore spans 8.02–9.08, whereas the text LLM judge spans 3.30–9.39.
BERTScore therefore varies less across configurations than the rubric-based text judge.
We retain both metrics because BERTScore measures similarity to the reference narration, while the text judge evaluates metadata alignment, narrative continuity, condition satisfaction, and ground-truth semantic consistency.
The correlation alone does not identify why individual systems differ between these metrics; the length analysis discussed separately provides the context for the verbosity pattern in the main text.
blocks.zh:
表F.1将基于参考的BERTScore与所有32个配置的LLM评分对照。
这两个度量衡是正相关联的,有中度的皮尔逊相关(r = 0.538 r = 0.538,p = 0.001 p = 0.001)和较强的阶次相关(ρ = 0.704\rho= 0.704,p = 6.9× 10− 6 p = 6.9\times 10^{-6}).
因此,获得较高文本评分的系统往往获得较高BERTS分数,而两个衡量标准则提供补充的系统一级信息。
它们的得分范围也明显不同:在比分到0–10后,BERTScore的得分跨度为8.02–9.08,而文本LLM法官的得分跨度为3:30-9.39。
因此,不同配置的BERTScore比基于标题的文本判断器差异较小。
我们保留了这两个衡量标准,因为BERTScore衡量与参考叙述相似,而文本法官则评价元数据校正、叙述连续性、条件满意度和地面真实语义一致性。
仅此关联性并不能确定为什么这些衡量标准之间单个系统存在差异;单独讨论的长度分析为正文中的动词模式提供了上下文.

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate the current generated images using DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023b ) , a perceptual image-distance metric.
We compare each generated image with the ground-truth next-page image from the current dataset using the default DreamSim ensemble and its official preprocessing.
Lower distances indicate greater perceptual similarity.
For each of the 32 configurations, we average distances over valid generated images; missing images are excluded from this analysis and remain part of the separate failure analysis.
The analysis contains 28,177 valid image pairs across 28,800 configuration–example slots, with 623 missing images.

我们使用DreamSim(Fu等人,2023年b),

距离越小,感觉就越相似。
对于32个配置中的每一个配置,我们平均距离超过有效生成的图像;缺失的图像被排除在本分析之外,并且仍然是单独故障分析的一部分.
该分析包含28,177对有效图像对,跨越28,800个配置-实例槽,有623个图像缺失.

blocks.en:
Table 8 compares these system-level means with the current evaluation scores.
DreamSim distance is negatively correlated with CLIP similarity ( r = − 0.982 r=-0.982 ), the three-judge image score ( r = − 0.910 r=-0.910 ), and the combined image modality score ( r = − 0.959 r=-0.959 ).
It is also negatively correlated with the three-judge integrated score ( r = − 0.728 r=-0.728 ) and the Total Average ( r = − 0.809 r=-0.809 ); all five correlations are significant at the nominal p < 0.05 p<0.05 level.
The four image rubric categories likewise have negative correlations with DreamSim distance ( r r from -0.922 to -0.881).
Thus, systems with stronger current image scores tend to produce images that are perceptually closer to the ground-truth next page.
This supplies a complementary perceptual-similarity check of the image evaluation, but does not directly measure narrative continuity or by itself establish a causal image bottleneck.
These correlations describe the 32 evaluated configurations, some of which share backbones or generated images; their nominal p p -values should not be interpreted as evidence from 32 independent model families.
blocks.zh:
表8将这些系统级手段与目前的评价分数进行比较。
DreamSim距离与CLIP相似性(r = − 0.982 r =-0.982),三位裁判的图像分数(r = 0.910 r =-0.910),以及综合图像模式分数(r = − 0.959 r =-0.959)呈负相关.
这与三个裁判综合分数(r = − 0.728 r =-0.728)和总平均分(r = − 0.809 r =-0.809)也有负相关关系;所有五个关联在名义p < 0.05 p < 0.05级别上都是显著的。
四个图像标题类别与DreamSim距离(r从-0.922到-0.881)也有负相关性。
因此,当前图像分数较强的系统往往会产生在感知上更接近地面真实的下一页图像.
这为图像评价提供了互补的知觉-同质性检查,但并不直接衡量叙述连续性,或本身就确立了因果图像瓶颈.
这些相关性描述了32个评估的配置,其中一些配置共享骨干或生成图像;其名义p-值不应被解释为来自32个独立模型家庭的证据.

blocks.en:
We further analyze what the integrated three-judge score captures at the system level.
As shown in Table 9 , it is positively correlated with all three modality-specific scores: text ( r = 0.987 r=0.987 ), image ( r = 0.871 r=0.871 ), and speech ( r = 0.870 r=0.870 ).
Its negative correlation with the newly recomputed DreamSim distance ( r = − 0.728 r=-0.728 , p = 2.3 × 10 − 6 p=2.3\times 10^{-6} ) indicates that configurations receiving higher integrated scores also tend to generate images that are perceptually closer to the ground truth.
These are associations between configuration-level averages, rather than causal effects or per-example agreement estimates.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步分析系统一级综合三司评分记录的内容。
如表9所示,它与所有三种模式特定分数正相关:文本(r=0.987 r=0.987),图像(r=0.871 r=0.871),语音(r=0.870 r=0.870).
它与新重制的DreamSim距离(r = − 0.728 r = -0.728,p = 2.3 × 10 − 6 p =2.3\times 10^{-6})的负相关关系表明,获得较高综合分数的配置也往往产生能感知到更接近地面真理的图像.
这些是配置级平均值之间的关联,而不是因果效应或每个实例协议的估计.

blocks.en:
Table F.3 examines the association with each modality after controlling for the other two modality scores.
Both text and image retain significant partial correlations with the integrated score: text has r = 0.921 r=0.921 ( p = 5.7 × 10 − 13 p=5.7\times 10^{-13} ), and image has r = 0.637 r=0.637 ( p = 1.5 × 10 − 4 p=1.5\times 10^{-4} ).
Speech has a smaller, non-significant partial correlation ( r = 0.123 r=0.123 , p = 0.519 p=0.519 ).
These results describe residual associations across the 32 configurations; they do not establish causal contributions or imply that speech is unimportant.
Under the current benchmark and judge ensemble, text and image scores distinguish integrated system performance more strongly after the other modalities are accounted for.
blocks.zh:
表F.3在控制其他两种模式的分数后,审查与每种模式的联系。
文字和图像都与综合分数保持显著的部分关联:文字有r=0.921 r=0.921(p=5.7×10−13 p=5.7\time 10×13),图像有r=0.637 r=0.637(p=1.5×10−4 p=1.5\time 10×4).
语音部分关联较小,非显著(r = 0.123 r = 0.123,p = 0.519 p = 0.519).
这些结果描述了32个组合的剩余关联;它们没有确定因果关系或暗示言论不重要。
根据目前的基准和评分组合,文本和图像分数在其他模式核算之后更有力地区分综合系统的业绩。

blocks.en:
We further decompose integrated evaluation into its four rubric categories.
Because the integrated score is the average of these category scores, correlations between a category and the integrated score are partly mechanical; Table F.3 instead summarizes the category-level bottlenecks.
Ground-truth semantic consistency has the lowest mean score (6.91), the largest share of category-level loss (32.1%), and the lowest score among the four categories for all 32 configurations.
Condition satisfaction has the largest cross-system dispersion (IQR=2.12).
Metadata alignment has the highest mean score (8.26) and the smallest loss share (18.1%).
Here, loss share is defined only within the four integrated-judge categories; it is distinct from any comparison of the three modality scores.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步将综合评价分为四个类别。
由于综合分数是这些类别分数的平均值,因此一个类别与综合分数之间的关联性是部分机械的;而表F.3则概括了类别级的瓶颈.
地面真实语义一致性的平均分数最低(6.91),在类别级损失中所占份额最大(32.1%),在所有32个配置中在四个类别中得分最低。
条件满意度的跨系统分布最大(IQR=2.12).
元数据校正的平均分数最高(8.26),损失份额最小(18.1%)。
在此,损失分担额仅在四个综合法官类别内界定;这不同于对三种模式分数的任何比较。

blocks.en:
Table F.3 relates each integrated category to the modality scores after controlling for the other two modalities.
Text and image have significant positive partial correlations with all four categories.
Speech has a significant positive partial correlation with metadata alignment ( r = 0.41 r=0.41 , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ), but not with multimodal continuity ( r = 0.20 r=0.20 , p = 0.288 p=0.288 ), condition satisfaction ( r = − 0.12 r=-0.12 , p = 0.530 p=0.530 ), or ground-truth semantic consistency ( r = − 0.10 r=-0.10 , p = 0.601 p=0.601 ).
Speech’s residual association is therefore concentrated in metadata alignment under the current evaluator ensemble.
The overall pattern is consistent with strong system-level associations between integrated judgments and both textual and visual quality, while ground-truth semantic consistency remains the most difficult rubric category.
blocks.zh:
表F.3在控制其他两种模式后,将每个综合类别与模式分数挂钩。
文本和图像与所有四类都有显著的正部分关联.
语音与元数据对齐(r = 0.41 r = 0.41,p = 0.025 p = 0.025),但与多式联运连续性(r = 0.20 r = 0.20,p = 0.288),条件满意度(r = − 0.12 r =-0.12,p = 0.530),或地面真实语义一致性(r = − 0.10 r =-0.10,p 0.601 p = 0.601)有显著的正局部关联.
因此,发言的剩余联系集中在当前评价者共同结构下的元数据统一。
总体模式与综合判断与文字和视觉质量之间强有力的系统层面联系是一致的,而地面真实语义一致性仍然是最困难的类别。

blocks.en:
Figure 12 summarizes the same integrated-judge category analysis.
In panel (a), the paradigm ordering is stable across all four categories: large orchestration is followed by semi-orchestration with T+S backbones and image-generation experts, small orchestration, any-to-any models, and semi-orchestration with T+I backbones and TTS experts.
Metadata alignment receives the highest mean score in every paradigm, whereas ground-truth semantic consistency receives the lowest.
Panel (b) shows positive partial correlations with text and image across all four categories; speech has a significant residual association only with metadata alignment.
Together, these descriptive results highlight the gap between metadata alignment and consistency with the specific ground-truth next-page event.

blocks.en: For MMaDA, the common generation-coverage factor is 713 / 900 = 0.7922 713/900=0.7922 ; for Emu3-9B, it is 850 / 900 = 0.9444 850/900=0.9444 . Each component mean is therefore reduced by approximately this factor, with small further reductions where an evaluator also fails on an available output. Table 14 compares valid-only and zero-filled scores for all 32 configurations and reports missing candidates separately for text, image, and speech. The group’s mean Total Average falls from 5.428 to 4.719 (a decrease of 0.709), driven principally by the larger MMaDA loss. The failure logs identify upstream planning-output errors, so this drop should not be attributed to degraded TTS quality on successfully generated examples. Valid scores are unchanged; the penalty applies to the failed examples, not to every example from these systems. The expanded comparison also shows modality-specific omissions outside TTS-expert semi-orchestration: HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni has 27 missing text candidates, 27 missing image candidates, and 115 missing speech candidates, whereas Omni-Diffusion has 0, 16, and 85, respectively. Their Total Average decreases are 0.457 and 0.254 points. Some configurations have no missing candidates but still receive slightly lower zero-filled scores because evaluation records can also be invalid. These differences therefore reflect both generation availability and evaluation validity, rather than TTS quality alone.

blocks.en: F.5 Human Evaluation and Agreement with LLM Judges
blocks.zh: F.5 人类评价和与LLM法官的协议

blocks.en: We conducted an independent human evaluation to assess whether LLM-judge scores agree with human judgments. Twenty-four annotators evaluated outputs from all 32 system configurations across four tracks: text, image, speech, and integrated (joint) evaluation. Human ratings were collected independently of the automated judge scores. The study used the same four rubric categories and 1–10 scale as the automated evaluation: metadata alignment, continuity, condition compliance, and ground-truth consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一次独立的人类评估,以评估LLM法官的得分是否符合人类判断。 24名注释员评价了所有32个系统配置的产出,分为4个轨道:文本、图像、语音和综合(联合)评价。 人类的收视率是独立于自动裁判分数来收集的. 该研究使用了与自动评价相同的四个类别和1-10尺度:元数据校正、连续性、遵守条件和地面真实一致性。

blocks.en: We selected a fixed common window of 10 story transitions from the 900-example benchmark and used the same window for every system and evaluation track. This defines 320 planned items per track and 1,280 in total, where an item is a system’s output for one transition in one track. The window was pre-selected rather than drawn through formal stratified sampling. Items were served through an annotation queue managed with the open-source tool Label Studio ( Tkachenko et al., 2020 ) , with a target of two ratings per item; annotators could skip items. One evaluation consists of an annotator’s four rubric scores for one item.
blocks.zh: 我们从900例基准中选择了10个故事过渡的固定共同窗口,并对每个系统和评价轨道使用同一窗口。 这界定了每道320项计划项目和总共1 280项计划项目,其中一项是系统在一个轨道中过渡的产出。 窗口是预先选择的,而不是通过正式分层抽样抽取的。 物品通过使用开源工具Label Studio(Tkachenko等人,2020年)管理的注释队列送达,目标为每件物品两次评分;注释员可以跳过物品. 一项评价包括一名注释员对一项评价的四个标分。

blocks.en: There were 697 submitted evaluations, of which 687 contained scores and 10 were skipped or unscored (Table 18 ). The 687 scored evaluations comprise 2,748 rubric-category scores. These are distinct counting units: the 1,280 planned items and the two-rating redundancy target should not be read as the number of completed evaluations. The mean coverage is 5.4 scored evaluations per system–track cell.

blocks.en: We compare per-system human means with the current three-judge means across the 32 configurations, using Spearman’s ρ \rho , Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} , and Pearson’s r r (Table 19 ). Human means weight each completed evaluation equally after averaging its four rubric scores. Automated means follow the main analysis: each judge’s valid-example mean over the 900-transition benchmark is computed first, and the three judge means are then averaged equally. Thus, the comparison relates the human study’s system-level rankings to the full-benchmark three-judge rankings. The unit of correlation is a system configuration, not an individual rubric score. The four-track composite equally averages the text, image, speech, and integrated rubric means; it is distinct from the main paper’s seven-component Total Average.

blocks.en: The independent human study supports agreement in broad system rankings and paradigm tiers under the shared rubric. blocks.en: These analyses condition on the evaluated configurations, generated candidates, judge families, and validity rules. They exclude uncertainty from rerunning generation, changing judge backbones, or sampling new model families, and do not measure sensitivity to component weights. The benchmark contains one transition per source–book pair, but possible cross-book republication or content dependence is not removed by resampling transitions. Shared backbones, experts, and candidate outputs also remain shared; applying identical resamples preserves this pairing without making the configurations independent. Valid-only uncertainty should therefore be read together with the reported failure and zero-filled analyses, and neither narrow intervals nor stable ranks establish causal effects or generalization beyond this benchmark.

blocks.en: The aggregate is a compact summary of heterogeneous measurements, and its exact ordering depends on the aggregation rule. We therefore retain modality-specific and rubric-category results alongside it; generation reliability remains a separate quantity. Length adjustment is observational and cannot establish whether judges favor verbosity itself, whether longer outputs better satisfy conditions, or whether shared rubric biases explain the association. It also cannot remove all differences in content or difficulty. The common-support restriction of M2 and the different valid-score denominators further limit interpretation. No generation, judge inference, or new human annotation is performed for these analyses.
